source.name: Crystal Palace FC: Temporal expands Crystal Palace partnership to become front-of-shirt partner of Palace Women
source.quote: Crystal Palace Football Club are delighted to announce that Temporal will expand its partnership with the Club to become the new front-of-shirt partner of Crystal Palace Women.
source.note: Temporal expands its men's front-of-shirt deal to Palace Women; no value reported.

note: Front-of-shirt partner of Crystal Palace Women, announced on 9 Sept 2026 for the 2026/27 season; no deal value reported.
